members.name: Deep periwinkle
members.purposeTemplate: Primary commands, focus emphasis, and the main {appName} identity color.
members.rationale: Deeper periwinkle keeps the requested identity while supporting white button text more clearly than the light tint.

members.name: Light periwinkle
members.purpose: Supporting brand tint for restrained highlights and identity surfaces.
members.rationale: Keeps the familiar light periwinkle available without using it behind white primary-action text.

presets.identityRationaleTemplate: The owner selected periwinkle as {appName} branding. Deep periwinkle carries primary emphasis; light periwinkle is a supporting tint. Derived interaction shades do not add identity colors.

matches: a little more vertical padding on buttons

presets.name: Soft off-white surface
presets.rationale: A restrained cool off-white reduces the starkness of pure white and coordinates subtly with the periwinkle identity without turning the background into an accent.

researchReferences.name: Carbon color overview
researchReferences.relevance: Carbon demonstrates a light background alternative using Gray 10 (#F4F4F4) and separates background and layer roles.

researchReferences.name: Material Web color theming
researchReferences.relevance: Material treats background and surface as semantic neutral roles generated within a theme rather than requiring pure white.

researchReferences.name: Atlassian color foundation
researchReferences.relevance: Atlassian separates neutral surface roles and recommends choosing tokens by semantic use.

presets.selectionNote: The exact #F7F7FC value is a fixture-specific synthesis, not a value claimed by all three systems.
